injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.short_comment: McConnell (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
injuries.long_comment: McConnell has missed the Pacers' last two games due to left hamstring soreness, and the questionable tag suggests the veteran floor general could be an option Friday. He's not expected to have a big role in most fantasy lineups, though, as he's averaging just 7.0 points, 4.3 assists, and 2.3 rebounds per game in his seven outings off the bench this season.

injuries.name: Larry Nance Jr.
injuries.short_comment: Nance (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
injuries.long_comment: Nance didn't return to Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle, and it remains to be seen whether the big man will be able to suit up Friday. He shouldn't cause a massive impact in most fantasy lineups with his absence, as Nance is averaging just 4.2 points and 2.2 rebounds per game in 17 appearances off the bench this season.

injuries.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
injuries.short_comment: Oubre is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers due to a right hand laceration.
injuries.long_comment: Oubre has been performing at a high level of late, scoring at least 15 points in six straight contests, but he could be forced to miss time due to a right hand injury. If he is out, Quenton Jackson could see extra minutes.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.short_comment: Haliburton (hamstring) has been ruled out per Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com for Friday's game against the 76ers. The guard participated in practice activities earlier this week as he continues working toward his return.
injuries.long_comment: Haliburton's return to practice is encouraging, but Indiana continues exercising caution with his hamstring injury. He is still expected to have his return in mid-December.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.short_comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
injuries.long_comment: Sheppard required a full repair and is without a definitive timetable for a return to action. With Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) expected to miss at least two weeks, Quenton Jackson figures to see a significant uptick in playing time. Two-way player Braden Smith could also see increased action with the parent club.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.short_comment: Embiid (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Pacers.
injuries.long_comment: Embiid has missed the team's last two games due to an illness, but it seems the star big man could return as soon as Friday -- or at least it sounds as if he has a chance to do so. Embiid has been turning things around of late, scoring at least 20 points in four games in a row and averaging 27.3 points, 8.0 rebounds, 5.0 assists and a combined 2.8 steals-plus-blocks per game over that stretch.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.short_comment: Brown (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
injuries.long_comment: Brown is set to undergo imaging of his hamstring, but all signs point to the star forward being on the verge of another spell on the sidelines. Brown has been out for just three games this season, but if he's forced to miss more time, Dean Wade could see an uptick in his playing time.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.short_comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
injuries.long_comment: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.
